# Gramlot examples 0.3.2 — Mobile gallery

- Responsive phone/tablet shell below 1024 CSS pixels with full-width Example, Code and Inspector views.
- Off-canvas navigation closes on page selection, backdrop or Escape and manages keyboard focus.
- View changes preserve the existing iframe, accepted Data, rejected input drafts and inspector selection; returning to desktop restores sidebar preferences.
- Normal preview uses automatic touch detection; explicit Mobile preview still forces touch sizing.
- Python, JavaScript and serverless share the same browser presentation. Python gallery source remains Python; the JavaScript gallery shows JavaScript.

Requires Gramlot >=0.3.1 for device-width server HTML and dynamic inspector docking. Dependencies retain no upper bound. The existing official ZIP download link and release-driven hosted deployment remain in place.

Verified: 98 JavaScript example/gallery tests, 18 Python tests, mobile widths 320/390/768/1023px in Chromium and WebKit on Python and Node, desktop regression checks, shared Data updates and rejected-draft retention.
